name: DOC_RAG_FINANCE_REPORT_BENCHMARK
description: A retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) benchmark for answering questions and generating summaries from financial reports and related documents. Measures how well systems retrieve relevant passages and produce accurate, concise finance-focused answers under domain-specific constraints. Designed to evaluate end-to-end RAG pipelines for finance-report QA and generation.
reputation: Niche Hugging Face dataset aimed at RAG evaluation for finance; modest adoption mainly among researchers and practitioners working on document-grounded finance NLP.
